lines.en: I drift slowly along the starlight.
The road is perfectly clear at night.
I pass the pond; stars sit on the water.
I follow a patch of brightness.

lines.zh: 我的脚步落在草上没声音。
lines.en: My steps on the grass make no sound.

lines.zh: 我往林子暗处走了一段。
lines.en: I walk a way into the dark of the woods.
The star points move along with me.

lines.zh: 我绕开了那道火把的光。
lines.en: I skirt around that torchlight.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己脚下的光。
lines.en: I look down at the light beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我要去数一数屋顶的星。
lines.en: I'm off to count stars on the roof.
I walk slowly; the night is long.
The wind makes my light waver.
I look up and name seven stars.

lines.zh: 我伸手把光捏成一颗小球。
lines.en: I shape the light into a little ball.
The night is quiet; I hear the insects.
I draw a circle on the grass.
My light reaches only as far as my feet.
One star is dim tonight.
I sit on a stone and watch the sky.
I'm practicing turning light into a thread.
The dew is cold; I tuck my feet in.

lines.zh: 我又忘了自己要做什么。
lines.en: I've forgotten what I meant to do again.
The cloud passes and the stars return.

lines.zh: 我把一颗小星放回天上。
lines.en: I put a small star back into the sky.
The night wind smells of water.
I get sleepy at the ninth star.

lines.zh: 我把光收进袖子，省着用。
lines.en: I tuck my light into my sleeve to save it.
Someone calls my name; I do not answer.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: I hear your breathing perfectly clearly.
You give off the warmth of something alive.
You stand in the dark and I see you.
Hold still; I'm reading your shape.
The star behind you is very bright.
Have you come out into the night too?
Your shadow is blocking a star.

lines.zh: 我认得活物的光，你不一样。
lines.en: I know living light; yours is different.
Good timing; it only just got dark.
There's a glint in your eyes.
I don't often talk to people.
Care to watch the stars with me?
Your steps are heavier than by day.
I counted how many steps you took.
My light got scattered.
It hurts more than a stumble at night.
I fall back half a pace and steady myself.
You broke my counting.
There's a hole burnt in my sleeve.
Shards of star fall all around.
I don't cry out; I just remember.
That made everything go white.
I need a moment to recover.
Even a light fairy can be hurt.
Sweets are best eaten at night.
The candy in your hand is wrapped in paper.
I won't snatch it; set it on the ground.
This tastes like fairy candy.
One for me and I'll remember you.
I only feel hungry at night.
Don't give too much; it will melt.
Just a tiny taste is enough for me.
Steady your hand; I don't bite.

lines.zh: 吃完我给你看点好东西。
lines.en: After eating I'll show you something nice.
You stepped on my light.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，都是凉的。
lines.en: We collide, both of us cool.
Kindly step aside; I need to pass.
You're heavier than I thought.

lines.zh: 我的头发挂在你扣子上了。
lines.en: My hair caught on your button.
That hurt, so you owe me an apology.
Don't push; the stars will scatter.
Step back and I'll stop wavering.
The night path is narrow; you go first.
Our bump struck off two sparks.
Of the three fairies, I speak least.

lines.zh: 你要是愿意，就坐到旁边。
lines.en: If you like, sit down beside me.
The night is long; stay a while.
I don't like noisy company.

lines.zh: 星落下来的时候要许愿。
lines.en: When a star falls, you must make a wish.
My memory is poor; don't blame me.
Let's keep one star until dawn.
Your hand is warmer than a star.
Fairies keep no one, only light.
I'll be here again tomorrow night.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗掉下来的星屑。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen fleck of star.
I hide this candy in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 地上有块会反光的石头。
lines.en: There's a stone on the ground that reflects.
I gather everything bright into my bag.

lines.zh: 这枚钥匙不知道开哪扇门。
lines.en: This key opens some door, I don't know which.

lines.zh: 捡到了就归我，夜里没人看见。
lines.en: Found means mine; no one sees at night.
I place it under a star to see it.
Too heavy, so I drag it the whole way.
This one is the twin of the other.
I'll keep it; tomorrow I'll decide.
The light over there is moving erratically.

lines.zh: 有个活物进了我的视线。
lines.en: A living thing came into my sight.

lines.zh: 它的光很热，和夜不一样。
lines.en: Its light is hot, unlike the night.
I see you; there's no use hiding.
It snapped a dry branch underfoot.
This is close enough to hit.

lines.zh: 我来看看它是什么东西。
lines.en: Let me find out what that thing is.

lines.zh: 它身上有别的东西的光。
lines.en: It carries the light of something else.

lines.zh: 夜里的动静都要查一遍。
lines.en: Every stir at night must be checked.
I drift over, keeping low.
Its shadow betrayed it first.
Once I mark it, it won't leave.
I time the rhythm of its breathing.
Light gathers in my palm.
Every three steps, it pauses.
I'm not hurried; dawn is far off.
I leave the bright side to it.
It's watching me; I know.
I edge left to block the path.
The stars shine on it and on me.
I dim my glow so it isn't startled.
This angle, and don't drift off it.
If it turns its head, I fire.
My light is drawn taut.
Two steps closer will be enough.
A line of light cuts across its shoulder.
My light strikes it in the chest.
The flash leaves it squinting.
I close in; it has no time to dodge.

lines.zh: 这一下是星落在我手上。
lines.en: That one was a star falling into my hand.
It's forced a step backward.
I add a thin beam of light.
I did warn you about this.
Light at night stings the most.
When it's over I'm still standing here.

lines.zh: 天黑下来，我就有了形状。
lines.en: Night falls and I take shape.

lines.zh: 我从一颗星的光里落下。
lines.en: I drop out of a star's light.

lines.zh: 池塘的水面把我照出来。
lines.en: The pond's surface brings me into being.
I'm back, and the stars are still there.
Of the three fairies, I arrive first.
Night dew falls and cools my shoulder.
I stretch, and my light spreads.
This time I don't want to be disturbed.

lines.zh: 林子里有股新叶的味道。
lines.en: The woods smell of new leaves.
I look up and count the stars first.
My feet make no sound as I land.
It's not fully dark; I wait.

lines.zh: 我的光把草照亮了一小片。
lines.en: My light brightens a patch of grass.
There shouldn't be rain tonight.
The firelight drowned out my stars.

lines.zh: 我从半空落下，摔在草里。
lines.en: I fell out of the air into the grass.
The water put out my light.
The blast flipped me over.

lines.zh: 那支箭擦着我的头发过。
lines.en: That arrow grazed my hair.

lines.zh: 这法术的颜色和星不像。
lines.en: This magic's colour isn't like starlight.
I'm so hungry my light fades.
Lightning outshone everything; I froze.

lines.zh: 我在往下坠，什么也看不见。
lines.en: I'm falling and I can see nothing.
